name: Pedralba de la Pradería (Spain)
description: White field with three blue pales in the upper half ending in points and three green pales in the lower half.
history: Municipal flag of Pedralba de la Pradería; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
